article.title: NFL EDGE Monday Morning Brief
article.dek: San Francisco rolled in Mexico City, the morning board is fresh again, and tonight is Cincinnati at Washington with both quarterbacks clear.

items.headline: San Francisco rolled in Mexico City, 35-10
paragraphs: Sunday night is settled. San Francisco beat Minnesota 35-10 in Mexico City, and it was not close after the first quarter. Brock Purdy threw for 255 yards and three touchdowns on 21 of 26 passing.
The 49ers are 9-1 now, the best record in the NFC. Minnesota falls to 7-3. San Francisco covered the 3.5 points with room to spare, and the 45 total points stayed under the 46.5 market total.
That closes the Sunday slate. Tonight is the only game left on the Week 11 board.
items.takeaway: San Francisco beat Minnesota 35-10 in Mexico City, covered the 3.5, and moved to 9-1. Sunday is done; tonight is Cincinnati at Washington.

sources.label: Reuters — 49ers rout Vikings in Mexico City return

items.headline: Tonight: Cincinnati at Washington, both quarterbacks clear
paragraphs: Monday Night Football is Cincinnati at Washington, 8:15 p.m. ET kickoff at Northwest Stadium in Landover. Both quarterbacks are clear. Joe Burrow starts for Cincinnati after an illness, and Jayden Daniels starts for Washington.
The app has Cincinnati by about 5 points. The market has the Bengals -6 on DraftKings, -5.5 on FanDuel, and -6.5 at Pinnacle. The total is 54.5.
items.takeaway: Tonight, 8:15 p.m. ET: Cincinnati at Washington. Burrow and Daniels are both clear to start, and the app has Cincinnati by about 5.

items.headline: Injuries: one Bengal out, four Commanders to watch
paragraphs: Cincinnati ruled out guard Dalton Risner with a knee injury. Three more Bengals are questionable: guard Dylan Fairchild, safety Kyle Dugger, and cornerback Dax Hill.

Washington has four questionable: running back Rachaad White, center Lucas Patrick, cornerback Amik Robertson, and running back Jacory Croskey-Merritt, who has resumed practicing and is in line to return. Left tackle Laremy Tunsil is on injured reserve.
None of this is final until the inactive lists land, about 90 minutes before kickoff. That is the moment to check if you are betting tonight.
items.takeaway: Risner is out for Cincinnati; White, Patrick, Robertson and Croskey-Merritt are questionable for Washington. Final answers come with the inactives, about 90 minutes before kickoff.

sources.label: SI — Commanders vs Bengals final injury report

items.headline: Tonight's weather: cool, light wind, rain unlikely
paragraphs: The final forecast for Landover has 56 degrees at kickoff, falling into the low 50s through the night. Wind from the northwest at about 10 mph. The chance of rain is 15 percent at 8:00 p.m. and near zero after that.
That is a touch warmer and calmer than the forecast from Sunday. Cool and dry, nothing that should change how the game is played.
items.takeaway: Landover tonight: mid-50s at kickoff, northwest wind about 10 mph, rain unlikely. Cool and dry.

sections.title: What It Means for NFL EDGE

items.headline: The board is fresh, and tonight has two cards
paragraphs: The morning board has refreshed, so these are today's numbers. Hit Rate takes Cincinnati to win outright at -295 on FanDuel. The app gives the Bengals about a 74-in-100 chance, and it will take the price down to -306.

Balanced takes Washington +6 at -107 on DraftKings. The app has Cincinnati winning by about 5, so 6 points is just past the app's number. That is the middle ground: a strong pick without paying too much.
There is no Value card tonight. Nothing on the board meets the Value contract, so the lane stays quiet. That is the lane working as designed, not a pick that went missing.

A quick reminder on price: -295 means every $2.95 you risk wins $1. Hit Rate is the pick most likely to win, not the best price on the board. If your book has a different number on either side, tap Check, type it in, and let the app run it back through the model and the evaluator.
items.takeaway: Tonight's cards: Hit Rate Cincinnati moneyline -295 on FanDuel, Balanced Washington +6 at -107 on DraftKings, and no Value play. Check your own book's price on either side.

items.headline: The model and the market nearly agree on this one
paragraphs: The app has Cincinnati by 5.18. The market has the Bengals between 5.5 and 6.5 depending on the book. That is not a big disagreement. It is the model and the market looking at the same game and landing in the same place.

When the two agree this closely, the edge is in the price, not the pick. Washington +6 on DraftKings is one side of it. If your book has Washington +6.5 or Cincinnati -5.5, that half-point is worth a Check before kickoff.
items.takeaway: The app says Cincinnati by about 5; the market says 5.5 to 6.5. When they agree this closely, shop the half-point — Check what your book has.

items.headline: Juice: the price of placing the bet
paragraphs: Every price carries a cost called juice, or vig. It is the book's cut, and it is baked into the odds. At -110, you risk $1.10 to win $1. At -120, you risk $1.20 to win the same $1.

Here is a clearly labeled hypothetical example. Imagine two books offering the same team at the same spread. One book lists it at -110, the other at -120. Same team, same spread, same game. The -110 ticket risks less to win the same dollar, so it is the better bet before the game even starts.
That is why the app's Check matters. A good pick at a bad price can still be a no-bet, and the same pick at a better price can be a bet. The pick did not change. The price did.
items.takeaway: Juice is what you risk to win a dollar — $1.10 at -110, $1.20 at -120 — so the same pick at a better price is a better bet. Always compare the price, not just the team.

items.headline: Cincinnati's number has not moved since last night
paragraphs: The Bengals are still -6 on DraftKings, -5.5 on FanDuel, and -6.5 at Pinnacle. The books are still a full point apart. The only change since the evening brief is the price: DraftKings moved from -114 to -113 on Cincinnati, and Washington +6 moved from -105 to -107.

Washington opened this game at +4 and is now +6, so the move toward Cincinnati happened earlier in the week. Overnight, the line sat still. The total is steady too, at 54.5 on DraftKings and FanDuel and 55 at Pinnacle.
If your book is not DraftKings or FanDuel, tap Check and type in your line and price. The app runs it back through the model and the evaluator and gives you a bet or no-bet verdict on your number.
items.takeaway: Cincinnati is still -6 on DraftKings, -5.5 on FanDuel, -6.5 at Pinnacle — the line has not moved overnight. The books still disagree by a full point, so Check your book's number.

items.headline: Sunday night: the favorite covered, the total stayed under
paragraphs: San Francisco closed at -3.5 and won 35-10, so the favorite covered with room to spare. The 45 total points finished under the 46.5 market total, and under the app's number near 49.5.
That is one result, not a signal. It settles the Sunday slate and nothing more.
items.takeaway: San Francisco covered -3.5 in a 35-10 win, and the 45 points stayed under the 46.5 total. One result, not a signal.

items.headline: Tonight: check the inactives, then check your price
paragraphs: Monday game? Monday check. The inactive lists land about 90 minutes before the 8:15 p.m. ET kickoff, and that is when the four questionable Commanders get their final answer. Check the inactives, then Check your prices.
If your book has Washington +6.5 or Cincinnati -5.5, that half-point is worth a Check before kickoff. A good number now beats a hoped-for number later.
And one honest note: settlement is manual, so the tracker only works if you are honest with yourself. Log tonight's result either way, losers included.
items.takeaway: Check the inactives about 90 minutes before the 8:15 p.m. ET kickoff, then Check your prices — and log the result honestly either way.
